description: Source code for FreeType PFR object methods, including face initialization, glyph slot management, and kerning functions.

methods.name: pfr_face_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with a PFR face object.

methods.name: pfr_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a PFR face object by loading font header, font data, and setting face properties.

methods.name: pfr_slot_init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph slot for PFR font rendering.

methods.name: pfr_slot_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a glyph slot.

methods.name: pfr_slot_load
methods.description: Loads a glyph outline or bitmap into a glyph slot, applying scaling and metrics calculations.

methods.name: pfr_face_get_kerning
methods.description: Retrieves kerning adjustment between two glyphs in a PFR font.
